description: Work out which car maintenance services (oil, tires, brakes, filters, coolant, plugs, transmission, battery) are due, due soon or ok from the current odometer and optional service history, and name the next one. Use to check what a car needs now. Do NOT use for prices (use service_cost_estimate) or a 12-month plan (use service_timeline).

km_per_month.description: Average distance driven per month in km (always km, 100-10000); adds a 'next due in about N months' hint

last_service.description: Optional per-service history, one entry per service id; items without an entry assume last service at odometer 0

months_ago.description: Months since this service was last done

odometer.description: Odometer when this service was last done, same unit as odometer and not above it

months_since_last_oil.description: Months since the last oil change; used as the time baseline for every item without its own history, default 0

odometer.description: Current odometer reading, non-negative, in the unit given by unit, e.g. 48000

unit.description: Unit of odometer and last_service odometer values: 'km' (default) or 'mi'

name: due_services

due_at_km.description: Odometer (km) at which the service is due; null for time-only items such as battery_check

due_in_months.description: Months from now until due by time (negative = overdue)

km_left.description: Km until due (negative = overdue); null for time-only items

months_left.description: Months left on the time interval (same as due_in_months)

status.description: 'due' (within 1000 km or 1 month, or overdue), 'soon' (within 3000 km or 3 months) or 'ok'

note.description: Summary counts, baseline assumptions and caveats

odometer_input.description: Odometer value and unit as supplied

odometer_km.description: Current odometer converted to km (1 decimal)

services.description: Status of every tracked maintenance service
